test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are six toys arranged one above the other in form of a stack, the lowermost is numbered 1 and the toy above it as 2 and so on. Each toy is of a different colour Purple, Pink, White, Yellow, Red and Grey. Purple toy is at the even position but not at the top. Red toy is not adjacent to white or yellow toy. Grey toy is at 5th position. There are two toys between pink and white toy where pink toy is above the white one. White toy is not at the bottommost position. At which position is the pink toy?
solution:
Colour : Purple, Pink, White, Yellow, Red and Grey.

Purple toy is at the even position but not at the top. Grey toy is at 5th position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dc0e160c3b019dc3ebf8b7f24500db32fb252c9bf1ee8d3e44c7453e57e4a7f.png] 

There are two toys between pink and white toy where pink toy is above the white one. White toy is not at the bottommost position. Red toy is not adjacent to the white or yellow toy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d11ee3cc949d7e998fb0ee05356813495f512614f84636ceeedec75a4c4d6b82.png] 

The figure are shown below –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb5a233cbb9e63cf3a771fb8d262bb61ef516bd214552d95491ae23ecb4991c6.png] 

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
